ProblemDetail.description: The RFC 7807 envelope every error response in this API uses.

type.description: Always 'about:blank' unless a more specific type is set.

title.description: Absent unless explicitly set -- both producers build the envelope through ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail, which populates status and detail only.

instance.description: The authentication entry point sets this explicitly so both producers' key sets agree.

errors.description: Present only on the field-validation response: field name to message.
